CommunityApplications.Profile:
Docker apps for using Ajazz and Mirabox LCD button pads with [Bitfocus Companion](https://bitfocus.io/companion).
**ajazz-companion-bridge** connects a pad plugged into your Unraid server to Companion's Satellite API: button pictures on the pad's screens, key presses, the touch strip, swipes and dials. Documentation, source and issue tracker: https://github.com/dvortsis/ajazz-companion-bridge
